design_action: Increase nominal arm cap and web to 1.5 mm; compensate only by back-rib width, keeping height and envelope unchanged.
candidate_selection: Use the measured BRep mass-versus-rib-width secant to target 1.195 kg, round rib width down to 0.01 mm, then check actual BRep mass. No large sweep.
mechanical_comparison: Run actual candidate combined -4 kN Z / +850 Nm Y with same dense elastic model and mesh9/mesh7 settings; report displacement, external work and global integration-point stress against V6f without claiming peak convergence. If an indicator worsens, report the tradeoff.
